public_contract.constructor: BoardDialogueJobs(controller, config, boot_id, *, asr=None, conversation_path=None, conversation_selection=None, scope_provider=None, profile_resolver=None, profile_release=None, visual_entry_handler=None, special_handlers=None, history_router=None, audio_converter=None, playback_invalidator=None, feedback_provider=None, inference_reconfigure=None, clock=monotonic, wall_clock=None, timezone='America/Los_Angeles', start_worker=True)
public_contract.stream: Existing aura-channel-1 start/transcript/text/control/audio/end plus network_complete; every emitted frame is validated by ChannelState before delivery.
public_contract.pcm: Default only 24000Hz mono PCM16; ordered 480-sample packets. Real OmniVoice RAM evidence confirms exactly this format.
public_contract.ack: Existing board player's complete-stream hook calls acknowledge(meta, result); typed 24k payload digest/count/token and the exact capture owner are checked, then original controller receipt is forwarded to BoardMemoryStore. No Windows /played route.
public_contract.mouth_clock: playback_clock(meta, playback_token=..., position_seconds=output.position()) returns audio_sample=round(position_seconds*24000). Neither native sample counts nor 48k stereo sink counts are treated as 24k mouth-clock positions.
public_contract.invalidate: submit/cancel/configuration/selection/close immediately invalidate generation/progress/presentation; boot/session/generation/request/capture and token are checked before playback, clock and ACK. Store/network cleanup uses a separate bounded queue.
public_contract.shared_cancel_event: Root-authorized narrow controller API: prepare_text/prepare_pcm/_start optional cancel_event; default preserves prior behavior. Jobs passes its per-capture Event, checked before/after registration. Every not-received transport error best-effort cancels its remote owner even when the shared Event is already set. No five-second polling loop remains.
public_contract.fail_closed: Missing board handlers, non24k without explicit reviewed bridge, missing trusted historical clock, excessive reply/audio bounds or cleanup overflow never call old Windows ASR/memory/identity/played endpoints.
